place.source_title: Peoples Banking and Trust Building, Putnam Street and 2nd Street

brief: Renaissance Revival bank-and-office building of 1923 on a corner: Bedford limestone, a ground floor of tall arched bays flanked by Ionic columns, plainer office floors above with dentilled cornices and a rooftop balustrade. The real building is four storeys; modelled at three.

facade.notes: the Peoples Banking and Trust building (Marietta OH, 1923): a four-storey Beaux-Arts bank-and-office building of cream terra cotta on a corner, a ground floor of tall arched windows, a deep cornice; traffic signals strung over the brick-paved intersection
